title: FancyZones does not respect default layouts

judgment.rationale: The reporter supplied the core sequence and a ZIP; current default selection exists in source, but the point at which it fails remains unknown.
evidence: On 0.87.1 a custom default layout is ignored until the FancyZones editor opens; the reporter supplied a diagnostic ZIP.
Another commenter reports separate horizontal and vertical defaults failing to follow monitor rotation.

AppliedLayouts::ApplyDefaultLayout selects horizontal or vertical defaults from monitor geometry: https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/blob/237dc893c8c76b1bfa65994afda41ea7315a914c/src/modules/fancyzones/FancyZonesLib/FancyZonesData/AppliedLayouts.cpp.

proposed_fixes.title: Apply FancyZones custom defaults without opening the editor
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Initial default loading, work-area identity, or orientation refresh may differ before the editor opens; the two reports could have different triggers.
plan: Reproduce the original startup sequence with a custom default and separately test orientation changes.
Compare loaded defaults, work-area IDs and monitor orientation before and after the editor opens.
Fix the confirmed initialization or refresh path and add coverage for default layout selection and orientation without requiring an editor launch.
verification: Custom defaults apply without opening the editor; horizontal and vertical defaults behave correctly on an orientation change.
